description: Source code for a thread-safe counter class named 'Counter', which provides high-throughput counting capabilities suitable for multi-threaded environments. The class inherits from 'Striped64' and includes methods for counting, incrementing, and adding values, utilizing atomic operations for thread safety.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A thread-safe counter class designed for high concurrency, derived from 'Striped64', that allows for safe incrementing and summing across multiple threads.

methods.name: Counter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Counter instance with an initial sum of zero.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current total count by summing the base value and all cells.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified long value to the counter, handling contention through atomic operations.
